theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 19 群

items.colloc: consult the users guide 查閱說明書 | follow the users guide 遵循指南
items.distinct: manual 操作手冊（更正式） | brochure 宣傳小冊子
ex: Please consult the users guide for setup instructions.
請查閱使用者指南以了解設定說明。
The users guide provides a troubleshooting section.
使用者指南提供了一個疑難排解章節。
Read the users guide before using the equipment.
使用設備前請先閱讀使用者指南。

items.colloc: have to wait for seats 必須候位 | wait for seats in the lobby 在大廳候位
items.distinct: reserve a seat 預訂座位 | take a seat 坐下
ex: Guests often wait for seats during peak hours.
顧客在尖峰時段常需候位。
We have to wait for seats at the restaurant.
我們得在餐廳等候入座。
Please wait for seats near the entrance desk.
請在櫃檯入口附近候位。

items.colloc: wait in line for tickets 排隊買票 | stand and wait in line 站著排隊
items.distinct: queue up 排隊（英式用法） | line up 排成一列
ex: Customers wait in line to purchase their tickets.
顧客排隊購買他們的票券。
He had to wait in line for thirty minutes.
他不得不排隊等了三十分鐘。
Please wait in line for your turn to register.
請排隊等待輪到你註冊。

items.colloc: request a wake up call 要求叫醒服務 | receive a wake up call 接到叫醒電話
items.distinct: alarm clock 鬧鐘 | morning call 晨間呼叫
ex: I would like to request a wake up call at seven.
我想要求七點的叫醒服務。
The declining sales served as a wake up call.
銷售下滑是一個警訊。
Front desk staff will handle your wake up call.
櫃檯人員會處理您的叫醒服務。

items.colloc: within walking distance 在步行距離內 | at a short walking distance 步行短距離
items.distinct: commutable distance 可通勤距離 | stone's throw 一箭之遙
ex: The hotel is within walking distance of the station.
飯店距離車站僅步行可達之處。
Our office is located at a convenient walking distance.
我們的辦公室位於方便的步行距離內。
Is the conference center within walking distance?
會議中心在步行可達的距離內嗎？

items.colloc: wear out the tires 磨損輪胎 | wear out the machinery 用壞機器
items.distinct: break down 故障 | consume 消耗
ex: These parts will eventually wear out with constant use.
這些零件在持續使用下終會磨損。
The heavy workload will wear out the staff.
沉重的工作負荷會讓員工精疲力竭。
He managed to wear out his shoes quickly.
他很快就把他的鞋子穿壞了。

items.colloc: check the weather forecast 查看天氣預報 | according to the weather forecast 根據氣象預報
items.distinct: meteorology 氣象學 | climate change 氣候變遷
ex: Please check the weather forecast before your trip.
旅行前請先查看天氣預報。
The weather forecast predicts heavy rain this afternoon.
氣象預報預測今天下午會有大雨。
We adjusted our outdoor event based on the forecast.
我們根據預報調整了戶外活動。

items.colloc: be well prepared for the meeting 為會議做足準備 | stay well prepared 保持準備狀態
items.distinct: fully equipped 裝備齊全 | ready-made 現成的
ex: The team was well prepared for the presentation.
團隊為簡報做了充分準備。
She is always well prepared for difficult questions.
她總是為難題做好萬全準備。
Being well prepared increases your chances of success.
準備充分能增加你的成功機會。

items.colloc: with respect to the contract 關於合約 | with respect to our policy 就我們的政策而言
items.distinct: in regard to 關於 | in terms of 在...方面
ex: We have some concerns with respect to the budget.
我們對於預算有一些擔憂。
There were no changes with respect to the deadline.
關於截止日期沒有任何變動。
The report provides details with respect to sales.
這份報告提供了關於銷售的細節。

items.colloc: work with the lights on 開著燈工作 | keep the office with the lights on 辦公室保持開燈
items.distinct: turn on the lights 開燈 | keep the lights on 保持開燈
ex: He prefers to work with the lights on.
他喜歡開著燈工作。
The warehouse was left with the lights on overnight.
倉庫整晚都沒關燈。
You can read better with the lights on.
開著燈你看書會比較清楚。

items.colloc: accommodate within reason 合理範圍內配合 | do within reason 在合理範圍內做
items.distinct: reasonable 合理的 | irrational 不理性的
ex: We can adjust the schedule within reason.
我們可以在合理範圍內調整行程。
The manager supports requests within reason.
經理支持合理範圍內的請求。
Expenses will be reimbursed within reason.
支出將在合理範圍內獲得報銷。

items.colloc: ensure it works properly 確保運作正常 | fail to work properly 無法正常運作
items.distinct: function well 功能良好 | operate efficiently 高效率運作
ex: Please check if the equipment works properly.
請檢查該設備是否運作正常。
The new software does not work properly yet.
新軟體目前無法正常運作。
We need the system to work properly by Monday.
我們需要系統在週一前運作正常。

items.colloc: wrap up the meeting 結束會議 | wrap up the project 總結專案
items.distinct: finish 完成 | summarize 摘要
ex: Let us wrap up the discussion in five minutes.
讓我們在五分鐘內結束討論。
He wants to wrap up the deal before leaving.
他想在離開前完成這筆交易。
The manager will wrap up the seminar soon.
經理很快會為研討會做總結。

items.colloc: a glass of water 一杯水 | a glass of juice 一杯果汁
items.distinct: a cup of 熱飲用杯 | a mug of 馬克杯
ex: Would you like a glass of water?
您想要來一杯水嗎？
She ordered a glass of wine for the guest.
她為客人點了一杯紅酒。
Each person will receive a glass of juice.
每個人會收到一杯果汁。

items.colloc: a great deal of effort 大量心力 | a great deal of money 大筆資金
items.distinct: a lot of 許多（口語） | a large amount of 大量（不可數）
ex: The project required a great deal of effort.
這項專案需要投入大量的心力。
We spent a great deal of time on research.
我們在研究上花費了大量的時間。
He has a great deal of experience in marketing.
他在行銷方面擁有豐富的經驗。

items.colloc: a series of meetings 一連串會議 | a series of events 一系列活動
items.distinct: a sequence of 一連串（強調順序） | a variety of 各式各樣
ex: The company announced a series of new policies.
公司宣布了一系列新政策。
A series of workshops will be held next week.
下週將舉辦一系列的工作坊。
He gave a series of lectures on economics.
他舉辦了一系列的經濟學講座。

items.colloc: a string of successes 一連串成功 | a string of failures 一連串失敗
items.distinct: a chain of 一連串（因果關係） | a series of 一系列
ex: The firm has enjoyed a string of successes.
該公司享有一連串的成功。
There was a string of errors in the report.
報告中有一連串的錯誤。
She dealt with a string of complaints today.
她今天處理了一連串的投訴。

items.colloc: adjust the rearview mirror 調整後視鏡 | adjust the mirror position 調整鏡子位置
items.distinct: fix the mirror 修理鏡子 | replace the mirror 更換鏡子
ex: Please adjust the mirror before you start driving.
開始駕駛前請先調整後視鏡。
He tried to adjust the mirror for better visibility.
他試著調整鏡子以獲得更好的視野。
Check if you need to adjust the mirror again.
檢查一下是否需要再次調整鏡子。

items.colloc: finish ahead of schedule 提前完成 | be ahead of schedule 進度超前
items.distinct: on schedule 按進度 | behind schedule 落後
ex: The construction project is ahead of schedule.
營建專案的進度超前。
We managed to complete the task ahead of schedule.
我們成功提前完成了任務。
Staying ahead of schedule gives us more flexibility.
進度超前給了我們更多彈性。

items.colloc: along with the report 連同報告 | along with his colleagues 以及他的同事
items.distinct: as well as 以及 | together with 和...一起
ex: Please send the invoice along with the report.
請連同報告一併寄送發票。
He attended the event along with his team.
他連同他的團隊參加了活動。
Documents are attached along with the email.
文件已連同這封電子郵件一併附上。
